newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-LE ROUX MAY MISS SPRINGBOK TOUR.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LE ROUX MAY MISS SPRINGBOK TOUR.

text.p: Transvaal fly-half Hennie le Roux may miss South Africa's tour of Argentina, France and Wales starting next month after injuring his leg in Saturday's Currie Cup final against Natal.
Transvaal team doctors said le Roux had a badly bruised shin bone but no fracture.
"The chances of me going on the Springbok tour are pretty slim unless a miracle happens. It seems I need at least a five week break," le Roux said.
If le Roux is unavailable World Cup fly-half Joel Stransky could be recalled to the South African squad.
